symptom: The first temporary-root fixture copied all 61 rebase-freeze members but omitted rebase-freeze-manifest.csv itself, which the builder reads directly.
impact: The builder stopped after writing only a temporary formal-32-baseline.csv inside the review directory. Prep, staging, and the formal root were unchanged.
correction: Copy the separately bound rebase-freeze-manifest.csv into the temporary mirror and rerun the static builder from the same isolated root.

symptom: The first rehearsal copy was placed under a long review path; Windows PowerShell could not copy a deeply nested registered endpoint into the mirror and raised DirectoryNotFoundException.
impact: The scenario stopped during mirror seeding before the transaction executor started. Prep, staging, and the formal root were unchanged.
correction: Run the exact frozen package through a temporary short drive mapping that points to the review-owned package copy, and remove the mapping after each scenario.

symptom: The ValidatorChecks helper omitted a space between return and the integer cast, so PowerShell treated return[int] as a command.
impact: The first derived scenario audit falsely marked all three scenarios failed. Original journals, outcomes, prep, staging, and the formal root were unchanged.
correction: Correct the helper to return ([int]...), then rebuild and replace both derived audit files from the original scenario evidence.

symptom: The derived order comparator treated two empty rollback sequences as unequal in the positive scenario.
impact: Only the derived positive scenario status was false; the 46-row journal, validators, outcome, and formal baseline evidence were correct and unchanged.
correction: Define the zero-versus-zero case explicitly as equal, then rebuild and replace the scenario audit from the frozen copies.

symptom: The generic empty-array equality helper still received unrolled empty arguments and returned false for the positive scenario rollback columns.
impact: The replacement derived audit again left only the positive row falsely failed; primary scenario evidence and formal data were unchanged.
correction: For expected zero rollback counts, validate the observed count directly; use ordered sequence comparison only for non-empty rollback sequences.

symptom: A read-only display command constructed the negative-gates summary filename incorrectly and requested a nonexistent path.
impact: Only that display command returned exit code 1 after the six gate rows had already been shown. The gate suite, copied evidence, prep, staging, and formal root were unchanged.
correction: Read the explicit negative-gates-summary.json path and continue the independent audit without rerunning the gate suite.

symptom: Windows PowerShell Remove-Item could not traverse several long residual mirror paths and left part of the review-owned temporary package copy.
impact: Cleanup was incomplete only under the independent review temporary directory. Persistent evidence, prep, staging, and the formal root were unchanged.
correction: Use a short drive mapping to the already validated review-owned temporary root, remove its explicit package-copy child, unmap the drive, and remove the now-empty temporary root.

symptom: The first short-drive cleanup attempt queried subst with an unsupported drive argument and therefore rejected a valid mapping before deletion.
impact: The command reached its finally block, removed the mapping, and did not delete anything. Prep, staging, and the formal root were unchanged.
correction: Verify the mapping from the complete subst listing, then remove the explicit Z:\package-copy child and the validated empty temporary root.

symptom: An overbroad read-only rg pipeline was truncated and returned a nonzero status while searching the frozen preparation documentation.
impact: The command made no file changes and did not affect prep, staging, formal data, or any transaction evidence.
correction: Read the exact execution contract and backup template with explicit file paths; confirm 23 rows and 23 unique relative paths.

symptom: A PowerShell foreach statement omitted required whitespace around the in keyword and failed to parse.
impact: The parser stopped before either report file was opened, so no file changed.
correction: Use valid PowerShell foreach syntax and verify both report files immediately after the replacement.

symptom: The first closure helper added an ad-hoc package aggregate re-serialization to an already verified contract and its compound condition failed before writing the closure artifact.
impact: The command was read-only until the failed condition and wrote no closure file. Prep, staging, formal data, and persistent evidence were unchanged.
correction: Use the frozen aggregate verification already recorded in baseline-freeze-summary.json, retain the fresh 67-member hash and byte audit, and check only the established invariants.
